title: CDN stale-while-revalidate
description: Serve the stale cached copy instantly while the CDN revalidates in the background. Triggers when origin slow or erroring; serves stale cached page. Example: Cache-Control: max-age=60, stale-while-revalidate=300.
provenance: Public record compiled from openly published documentation, project sources, and standard references.

title: Service worker offline page
description: A service worker serving a cached app shell and offline page when the network fails. Triggers when network failure; serves cached shell + offline page. Example: workbox precaching + catch handler.
provenance: Public record compiled from openly published documentation, project sources, and standard references.

title: nginx try_files cascade
description: try_files walks a list of files and falls back to a static page or named location. Triggers when missing file/route; serves fallback file. Example: try_files $uri $uri/ /fallback.html;.
provenance: Public record compiled from openly published documentation, project sources, and standard references.

title: Pre-rendered error pages
description: Static 50x pages served by the edge so error pages never depend on the app server. Triggers when 5xx from origin; serves branded static page. Example: error_page 500 502 /50x.html;.
provenance: Public record compiled from openly published documentation, project sources, and standard references.

title: DNS failover
description: Route 53 health checks flip DNS to a standby region when the primary fails checks. Triggers when health-check failure; serves standby region. Example: Route 53 failover routing policy.
provenance: Public record compiled from openly published documentation, project sources, and standard references.

title: Read-only degraded mode
description: Disable writes but keep reads serving from replicas during an incident. Triggers when primary DB down; serves read traffic. Example: feature flag: writes_enabled=false.
provenance: Public record compiled from openly published documentation, project sources, and standard references.

title: Last-known-good API cache
description: The edge serves the last successful API response with a warning header when origin dies. Triggers when origin 5xx/timeout; serves last good JSON. Example: stale-if-error=86400.
provenance: Public record compiled from openly published documentation, project sources, and standard references.

title: Static mirror
description: A periodic rsync mirror of the site that the load balancer promotes when the app tier fails. Triggers when app tier down; serves mirrored static site. Example: rsync -a --delete origin::www /mirror.
provenance: Public record compiled from openly published documentation, project sources, and standard references.

title: Maintenance page with Retry-After
description: A 503 plus Retry-After tells clients and crawlers to come back instead of hammering. Triggers when planned downtime; serves 503 + Retry-After. Example: return 503; add_header Retry-After 3600;.
provenance: Public record compiled from openly published documentation, project sources, and standard references.

title: PWA app shell
description: The shell (header/nav) loads from cache instantly; only content waits on network. Triggers when slow network; serves instant shell. Example: cache.addAll(["/","/shell.html"]).
provenance: Public record compiled from openly published documentation, project sources, and standard references.

title: Feature-flag kill switch
description: Flags disable the broken feature in seconds without a deploy. Triggers when feature incident; serves reduced functionality. Example: flags.new_checkout=false.
provenance: Public record compiled from openly published documentation, project sources, and standard references.

title: Image onerror placeholder
description: onerror swaps broken images for a local placeholder so layouts never collapse. Triggers when image 404; serves placeholder. Example: .
provenance: Public record compiled from openly published documentation, project sources, and standard references.

title: API snapshot fallback
description: Edge workers serve yesterday’s snapshot of an API feed when the generator stalls. Triggers when feed generator stalled; serves snapshot JSON. Example: KV-stored daily snapshot.
provenance: Public record compiled from openly published documentation, project sources, and standard references.

title: Outbox queue for writes
description: Writes queue locally (outbox pattern) and sync when the backend recovers. Triggers when backend unreachable; serves queued writes. Example: SQLite outbox + sync worker.
provenance: Public record compiled from openly published documentation, project sources, and standard references.

title: Pre-built static export
description: A nightly static export of the whole site stands ready behind the dynamic one. Triggers when dynamic tier failure; serves full static site. Example: next export && sync to edge.
provenance: Public record compiled from openly published documentation, project sources, and standard references.
